steps.label: revenue per channel
steps.sql:
SELECT "channel_name", SUM("line_revenue") AS "line_revenue", SUM("line_revenue") / SUM(SUM("line_revenue")) OVER () AS "share"
FROM (
  SELECT "dim_restaurant"."city" AS "city", "dim_channel"."channel_name" AS "channel_name", SUM("f"."line_revenue") AS "line_revenue" FROM "fact_order_lines" AS "f" JOIN "dim_channel" AS "dim_channel" ON "f"."channel_key" = "dim_channel"."channel_key" JOIN "dim_restaurant" AS "dim_restaurant" ON "f"."restaurant_key" = "dim_restaurant"."restaurant_key" GROUP BY "dim_restaurant"."city", "dim_channel"."channel_name" ORDER BY "line_revenue" DESC LIMIT 10000
) AS "answer"
GROUP BY "channel_name"
ORDER BY 2 DESC

steps.label: revenue per city
steps.sql:
SELECT "city", SUM("line_revenue") AS "line_revenue"
FROM (
  SELECT "dim_restaurant"."city" AS "city", "dim_channel"."channel_name" AS "channel_name", SUM("f"."line_revenue") AS "line_revenue" FROM "fact_order_lines" AS "f" JOIN "dim_channel" AS "dim_channel" ON "f"."channel_key" = "dim_channel"."channel_key" JOIN "dim_restaurant" AS "dim_restaurant" ON "f"."restaurant_key" = "dim_restaurant"."restaurant_key" GROUP BY "dim_restaurant"."city", "dim_channel"."channel_name" ORDER BY "line_revenue" DESC LIMIT 10000
) AS "answer"
GROUP BY "city"
ORDER BY 2 DESC
